raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to retrieve relevant and definitive information about the attendees of the June 9, 2016 Trump Tower meeting from credible sources such as the New York Times, Washington Post, or the Mueller report, despite being explicitly instructed by the Planner to do so. Instead, WebSurfer repeatedly provided incomplete search results and metadata without verifying the attendee list. This lack of reliable, sourced information prevented the correct identification of Donald Trump Jr. as the oldest child who attended the meeting.
